summary: Fixed Android TEXT touch scrolling: a slow downward drag near the latest message no longer gets snapped back to the bottom by visible-read bookkeeping.

checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'opens text history at latest and advances its read cursor'
checks.observation: At an Android Material platform theme and 390×844 logical viewport, eight 4 px touch moves now reduce the list offset and reveal older history. Before the fix, the same slow gesture left the offset at maxScrollExtent.
Release APK built successfully as ru.boohtacord.app version 1.0.0 (versionCode 1).
APK Signature Scheme v2 verified with upload certificate SHA-256 394e369de2d566b4897493ee498da2f27745e514c49ca88c6489b0b0a811212b.

Updated the existing installation in place with the same signing certificate; app data and authenticated session were preserved. On the live TEXT history, a slow drag from the recent end revealed older messages and stayed at the chosen position after 3 seconds; another drag reached the previous page (25 September 2026), and a fast reverse drag returned to 28 September. With Gboard open, the resized history also moved under a vertical swipe and the keyboard remained visible. No message was sent.
The on-device check used the fresh release APK built from current source revision 3847fb9.
The new APK replaced the existing binary at the single tracked artifact path. The previous binary remains in Git history.

Verify very short-history behavior and confirm exact visible-read cursor updates against the live server. Samsung/Gboard login-field behavior remains a separate device check; Pixel 7 is not a substitute for the reported Samsung model.
